criteria.name: Impact Potential & Innovation
criteria.description: How much would this matter for AI safety if it worked? How innovative is it? For scores of 4-5: is this actually new to the field, or replicating recent work?

scale.1: Negligible. No clear problem addressed, or no meaningful novelty.
scale.2: Limited. Addresses a real problem but with a generic or well-trodden approach. Incremental at best.
scale.3: Moderate. Clear problem with a reasonable approach; some novelty in framing or method beyond routine application of existing tools.
scale.4: Significant. Important problem with an original approach, or identifies a neglected problem area. A valuable contribution others could build on.
scale.5: Exceptional. Tackles a critical AI safety problem with a genuinely novel approach, or opens a new research direction. Clear theory of change. You'd be excited to share this with researchers in the area.

criteria.name: Execution Quality
criteria.description: How sound are methodology, implementation, and findings?

scale.1: Seriously flawed. Methodology broken, results uninterpretable, or implementation doesn't work.
scale.2: Weak. Approach has significant gaps: missing validation, flawed experimental design, or incomplete implementation.
scale.3: Competent. Technically solid given the short duration. Methodology makes sense, results are interpretable, limitations acknowledged, work builds toward clear conclusions.
scale.4: Strong. Thorough methodology with convincing validation. Results clearly support conclusions. Immediately useful for future work.
scale.5: Exceptional. Ambitious scope executed rigorously. Surprising findings, novel methods, or unusually robust validation.

criteria.name: Presentation & Clarity
criteria.description: How clearly are work, findings, and impact potential communicated?

scale.1: Incomprehensible. Cannot determine what the project is actually claiming or doing.
scale.2: Hard to follow. Key information buried, missing, or diluted by excessive length. Significant effort to extract main points.
scale.3: Clear enough. Can understand the problem, approach, and results without undue effort. Core content clearly present: problem, method, findings, limitations.
scale.4: Well presented. Easy to follow, well-structured, appropriate level of detail. Target audience would get it quickly.
scale.5: Exceptionally clear. A pleasure to read. Complex ideas made accessible. Could serve as a model for how to present this type of work.
